description:
Cast Rograkh by paying {0} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax (if applicable).
Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Roxi to your hand and returning any stickers on it to your sticker sheet.
Cast Roxi by paying {2}{U}{R}.
Roxi enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Cloudstone Curio.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning Rograkh from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Roxi trigger, putting two art stickers onto itself.
Goblin Airbrusher triggers, creating four Treasure tokens.
Activate four Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them to add {2}{U}{R}.
Repeat.
